Binary export omits the normal record on each second triangle, misaligning the file: 55 degenerate triangles and 53 missing normals in the captured 96-triangle export.

The input handler updates state before hitting the missing preview control in the shim; the changed exported width is evidence of state update, not full successful rendering.
